tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Spring & REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Senior Java Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience designing and developing SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong background in Java, Spring, RESTful OCC APIs, and database performance tuning, combined with deep hands-on expertise in technical design and customer requirements analysis. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer experienced in delivering scalable e-commerce architectures, third-party integrations, and automated CI/CD deployments within agile team environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: (Senior) Java Developer
cover_en.hook: With over five years of enterprise experience engineering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I translate complex customer requirements into high-performing technical designs. Your opening for a (Senior) Java Developer aligns perfectly with my track record of architecting scalable Java/Spring backend services and robust e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Technical Architecture & Core Java
bullets.text: Designed and developed backend architecture across SAP Commerce 2105 and 2211 utilizing Java, Spring, and design patterns to ensure maintainable, high-throughput e-commerce execution.

bullets.label: Requirements Analysis & Solution Design
bullets.text: Partnered closely with business stakeholders and technical peers to analyse customer requirements, author functional specifications, and translate them directly into production-ready software solutions.

bullets.label: Omnichannel & Headless APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services for headless commerce storefronts, customizing interceptors, populators, and converters for seamless third-party consumer integrations.

bullets.label: Integration & Performance Optimization
bullets.text: Engineered complex data integrations linking PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms, and led database query refactoring that significantly lowered latency and improved transaction speed.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit and am serving my notice period with Rockwell Automation until 15 December 2026, making me available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my technical background can support your engineering team.

tailoring.why_company: I am motivated by your commitment to delivering high-quality enterprise commerce solutions and your engineering-focused culture. Having spent over five years driving complex SAP Commerce Cloud and Java implementations for global enterprises, I want to bring my architectural expertise in Spring, headless APIs, and systems integration to a team where technical design excellence and customer-centric software delivery directly create business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java/Spring development at Shell and Rockwell Automation, I specialize in turning complex requirements into robust technical designs. I am excited to bring certified Hybris engineering and integration expertise to your development team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw your opening for a (Senior) Java Developer. With 5+ years building SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Java/Spring backends at Shell and Rockwell Automation, I translate customer requirements into scalable technical designs. I would welcome the chance to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for (Senior) Java Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the (Senior) Java Developer position. With over five years of professional experience developing enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms using Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in translating complex customer requirements into scalable technical architectures. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my qualifications with you in an interview.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
